args.title: Saltmarsh Foods Newsletter Summary – Retail Returns Logistics
args.body:
- Apparel return rates have climbed to 24%, making returns a significant cost and logistics challenge for retailers.
- Consolidated return hubs are an effective mitigation, cutting handling costs by roughly one-fifth.
- Companion piece insight: reselling returned items within 10 days preserves most of the original margin, emphasizing speed-to-resale as a key profitability lever.
